name: Protection from Energy

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Touch willing creature; select Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder Resistance; source Concentration, not general all-damage Resistance.

rules.text: For the duration, the willing creature you touch has Resistance to one damage type of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.
